content_of_post_to_answer: What is one simple health habit that has made the biggest difference in your everyday life?
answer: The health habit that changed my life most was treating sleep as a non-negotiable, not as leftover time after everything else was done. I noticed that many "health problems" were actually decision-making problems caused by being exhausted. Better sleep quietly improved food choices, patience, focus, and consistency. I've written more about this connection between daily energy and habits on my profile if you want to explore it further. The best health habits are often the ones that make every other good choice easier.
